program.name: Flexibility Volume
program.subject: Flexibility
program.blurb: Three long stretch sessions: hamstrings and splits, hips and straddle, then shoulders and spine.
program.about: Flexibility with the time it needs. Long holds for the hamstrings and front splits, for the hips, groin and straddle, and for the shoulders, chest and spine. Each opens with a short flow and ends on its deepest stretch. Three days rotate. Both later levels hold every stretch longer.
program.split: Hamstrings & splits / hips & straddle / shoulders & spine
